purpose: Separate source-only fallback regression diagnostic; never an Open Babel ranking or replacement for fixed profiles.
transformation: Split every numeric V30 atom and bond row after its id using a V3000 continuation. Keep all 64 records, names, atoms, bonds and coordinates.
source_equivalence_gate: Compare full baseline/candidate native snapshots and rewrites, and original-chain baseline snapshots and rewrites, byte for byte.
negative_policy: Retain all outcomes. Select one separate 21-block all-mode follow-up if any initial interval is wholly below 1; no pooling or recursive retries.
